scope: On the Becoming core, a policy on observations implements correction over admitted histories exactly when its action on each observation value is a common response of the judgment process on that value's cell; a common action exists exactly when every cell has a common response; and a choice is safe at an observation value exactly when it is a common response on the worlds that show it. CorrectionBoundary.refine_observation and ObservationChange.refinement_preserves_safe_choice are rederived from the core's commonResponse_antitone. Correspondence of histories, observations and success to an actual system, and the warrant of any success relation, are not checked.
